run: 3:00 PM ET run. Built around tonight's injury-depleted NBA games (76ers, Thunder, Rockets, Hornets), goalie mismatches (Fowler vs Murashov, Sergeev's debut), and college QB/line injuries (Washington, Arkansas, Clemson's passing game). Every leg starts at 5:10 PM ET or later, and none repeats a morning selection.

singles.reason: Both rosters are gutted. Philadelphia is on the second night of a back-to-back without Joel Embiid, LeBron James, Barlow and Hukporti, and Jaylen Brown is questionable. Charlotte is without Kon Knueppel, Coby White and Grant Williams. That takes away the top creators on both sides, and a tired road team should slow the pace. The main total is 212.5; taking 210.5 at plus money (+104) applies our NBA lesson that injury and pace unders have been our most reliable NBA angle.

Oklahoma City is down six rotation players (Holmgren is out 8-10 weeks, plus Jalen Williams, Caruso, Cason Wallace, Topic and Sorber). Houston is on the second night of a back-to-back without Fred VanVleet, Reed Sheppard and Steven Adams. These are two top-five defenses, and Houston plays one of the slowest paces in the league. Sengun is back, but he slows Houston's half-court tempo even more. The main total is 218.5; 217.5 pays +104.

Clemson hasn't thrown a touchdown pass since September 19. Freshman QB Tait Reynolds is starting, and WR Sellars is out. Clemson scored 16, 13 and 10 in three of its last four games against real defenses. The State's beat writer projects FSU 27-17. The risk is that Florida State's defense ranks 130th in yards allowed, but the Noles allow far fewer points at home than on the road. 20.5 at +112 sits just under the 21.5 main team total.

Washington QB Demond Williams Jr. is a game-time decision, and RBs Jayden Limar and Trey Cooley are both questionable. Nebraska is 6-1 ATS (4-1 at home), with DL Riley Van Poppel probable to return off a bye, and 66% of consensus picks are on the Huskers -7.5. A night road game in Lincoln with a backup or banged-up QB fits our team-total-under rule (a weak offense in a tough spot). 19.5 pays +104.

parlays.name: Goalie Mismatch NHL
parlays.reason: Two goalie-driven legs where one team has a big goaltending edge. Lesson applied: our goalie angle has been profitable, and we keep safe parlays to 2-3 legs.

legs.reason: Montreal's Fowler has a .944 save percentage and has won 6 straight starts. Pittsburgh starts Murashov (.880, 0-3-1). Montreal is at home and has won 4 in a row, even without Suzuki and Demidov.
Columbus ranks 29th in scoring, and Oettinger is in net at home. Greaves (.883) has been shaky, but Dallas tends to win low-event games. This gives us a goal of cushion over the 5.5 main total.

parlays.name: Prime-Time CFB Favorites (Alt Lines)
parlays.reason: Three favorites, each facing an opponent with key injuries, with the lines bought down far below the main spreads. Lesson applied: check the underdog's health, and use cushion over coin flips.

legs.reason: Clemson's passing game has stalled (no passing TD in six weeks, with a freshman QB), and FSU is at home. FSU is without RBs Kromah and Singleton, so we take -1.5 instead of the -5.5 main line.
Washington's QB and two RBs are game-time decisions. Nebraska is 6-1 ATS and coming off a bye. We take -3.5 instead of the -7.5 main line.
Arkansas is missing its starting center (Kitler), its top TE (Lassiter) and DB Braydon Lee, and WR Chris Marshall is questionable. We take -4.5 instead of the -10.5 main line.

parlays.name: Short-Handed NBA Dogs (Alt Lines)
parlays.reason: Two home teams in games where the opponent is missing more key players, with points added. These are not coin-flip moneylines (lesson: no -110 to -150 MLs).

legs.reason: Philadelphia is on the second night of a back-to-back without Embiid or LeBron, and Jaylen Brown is questionable. Charlotte is at home, and the moneyline is a pick'em (-108).
Houston (5-1) gets Sengun back at home. OKC is without Holmgren, Jalen Williams, Caruso and Wallace. The Rockets are a -144 moneyline favorite, so +1.5 adds a cushion.

lottery.name: Best Shot $500K
lottery.reason: A $5 ticket on 25 legs, one per event, built to roughly 100,000-to-1 (about $500K). Every leg is a bought-down alt line or a short-handed or weak-goalie angle from today's research: NBA injury unders and spreads, weak-goalie NHL team totals, college QB and line injuries, and cushion unders. No leg repeats any morning selection or any other ticket in this run, and there are no coin-flip moneylines.

legs.reason: New Orleans is without Poole and Missi. Atlanta is a -184 moneyline favorite, and Covers projects the Hawks at 68%.
The main total is 6.5, so this gives a full goal of cushion. Only about 1 in 5 NHL games reach 8+ goals.
Pittsburgh's Murashov (.880) is 0-3-1.
Columbus' Greaves has an .883 save percentage. Dallas is at home.
Calgary's Sergeev is making his season debut on the second night of a back-to-back with no morning skate. Colorado's team total is 4.5.
Milwaukee is 1-4 with a -10.8 point differential. Cleveland is -400 on the moneyline.
Minnesota is without Edwards and DiVincenzo, and Gobert is questionable. San Antonio is -600 on the moneyline.
Memphis is 5-0. Sacramento is winless and without Murray, Cardwell, Raynaud and Simmons.
Both teams are short-handed with two elite defenses (same angle as our single, with 5 extra points).
Six-plus rotation players are out between the two teams, and Philadelphia is on a back-to-back.
Clemson's offense has stalled, and FSU is missing two RBs. The main total is 49.5.

legs.pick: Washington State @ San Diego State Under 50.5
legs.reason: San Diego State plays a ball-control style with an elite defense. The main total is in the high 40s, so this gives a 3+ point cushion.
This is a 3-point cushion over the 55.5 main total in a Sun Belt rivalry game.
Iowa State's QB depth is thin. Oklahoma State is -345 on the moneyline.
Miami is a -600 favorite over a weak UNC offense (UNC's team total under 21.5 is priced at -172).
Ohio State is without QB Julian Sayin, so freshman Fahey starts. The main total is 49.5, so this gives 4 points of cushion.
Mississippi State's starting QB is out for the season. The Bulldogs scored 0 and 15 in Parker Puckett's two starts.
Pitt is a -295 home favorite. The main spread is about -8.5, so -5.5 is bought down.
Arkansas is without its starting center and top two TEs, facing a ranked Missouri defense.
This is a pure cushion leg: Washington stays within two scores even with a backup QB. We use it so we don't stack another Nebraska leg.
Army's option offense shortens the game. The main total is 59.
Boise State is a -450 home favorite on the blue turf. The main spread is about -12, so -8.5 is bought down.
UNLV is a -2000 favorite at home.
This is a late game with a 4+ point cushion over the main total.
Marshall is a -205 favorite over Dakota Hope.

lottery.name: UFC Favorites Ladder
lottery.reason: Eight UFC favorites from tonight's Vegas card, each priced at roughly 70% or better and backed by expert and prediction-market consensus, plus one late tennis favorite. Lesson applied: lottery legs should be about 75% or better, with no coin flips (we skipped the Moicano-Nolan main event at -126).

legs.reason: Szabova is a -670 favorite. The prediction market gives her 86%, and expert picks agree.
Kropschot is a -340 favorite (75% in the prediction market). Experts expect him to win by submission.
Reese is a -405 favorite (79% in the market). The consensus is a stoppage over a declining Mickey Gall.

legs.event: Jean Paul Lebosnoyani v Farman Hasanov
legs.reason: Lebosnoyani is a -295 favorite over Hasanov.
Luana Santos is a -320 favorite over Yana Santos.
Jacobe Smith is a -260 favorite (71% in the market), and MMA Junkie's staff and readers both pick him.
Piera Rodriguez is a -295 favorite over Talita Alencar.
Sezinando is a -178 favorite over Berggren.
Shnaider is a -162 favorite on hard court, and this match starts late, so it isn't an early-tennis leg.

history.name: Injury-Edge NBA Favorites
history.whyExplanation: Lost on one leg: Toronto lost 121-114 at home to Orlando. Miami and Detroit both won easily.
history.lesson: A short-priced home favorite is not safe just because of injury news. Orlando's healthy starters outscored Toronto in the first half. Check whether the underdog is fully healthy before using a -230 favorite as filler.

history.name: Unders Trio

legs.event: New Jersey Devils @ Vegas Golden Knights

history.whyExplanation: Lost two of three legs. Devils-Golden Knights went to 7 goals and Baylor-UCF finished at 50 (41-9), so a one-sided blowout still beat the under. Pistons-Nets under hit easily (204).
history.lesson: Unders in college football blowouts are risky because the favorite can score on its own. Use unders only where both offenses are weak. The NBA under based on pace and injuries was right.

history.name: 1st-Quarter Scorers
history.whyExplanation: Lost on one leg: Brunson scored only 2 first-quarter points because he was setting up teammates (two assists). Flagg had 12, Giannis 7, and Barnes and Garland 7 each.
history.lesson: Even -1200 legs miss. Five heavy favorites stacked together still lose about 1 time in 3 to 4. Use fewer legs, and avoid players whose first-quarter role is passing.

history.whyExplanation: Lost two of three legs. Celtics -15.5 missed by half a point (won by 14) and the Knicks lost 98-93. Baylor won 41-9.
history.lesson: Following sharp money is not enough. Big NBA spreads like -15.5 often miss late when the leading team rests its starters (Chicago scored 37 in the 4th quarter). Avoid spreads of 12 points or more on parlays.

history.whyExplanation: Lost two of three legs. The Lakers lost by 17, Kent State lost 31-10, and the Nuggets covered -4.5.

history.name: Goalie & Pace Overs
history.whyExplanation: WON at +599. Kraken-Flames went to 8 goals, Nuggets-Suns to 247 and Bulls-Celtics to 236, clearing 235.5 by half a point.
history.lesson: Picking overs from weak goalie form and fast-paced NBA matchups worked. Keep this method, but note that the Celtics leg needed a garbage-time 4th quarter, so it was partly luck.

history.name: Injury-Usage Props Lottery

legs.event: Los Angeles Lakers @ Golden State Warriors

history.whyExplanation: Lost: 4 of 6 hit. Davis, Curry, McDaniels and Edgecombe hit. Cunningham had 5 rebounds and Barnes had 5, each missing by one.
history.lesson: Picking players who gain usage from injuries mostly worked (4-2). Rebound overs set right at the season average are close to coin flips, so pick props where the line is 1.5 or more below the player's recent average.

history.name: Notre Dame 1st Quarter -7.5

legs.actual: ND 7, Navy 3 after 1Q (won the quarter by 4)

history.whyExplanation: Lost. Notre Dame led only 7-3 after the first quarter. Navy kicked a field goal on its opening drive, and the Irish didn't take over until the second half (35-13 final, so the full-game read was right).
history.lesson: First-quarter spreads of 7 or more need a fast-starting offense AND an opponent that can't move the ball early. Service academies' ball-control offenses shorten the first quarter, so take the full game or 1H instead of a 1Q line against option teams.

topLessons: Coin-flip moneylines (-110 to -150) killed the long tickets: 0-4 in the morning Best Shot. Lottery legs need ~75%+ true probability.
Big NBA spreads (-12 or more) are fragile in garbage time: Celtics -15.5 won by 14 and missed twice.
Do not carry a failed-risk leg into multiple tickets; correlated reuse turned one miss into three losses (Kent St, Kraken, Celtics, Lakers).
Pace/goalie-driven overs and injury-usage unders/props were the best angles (Overs parlay won +599; singles 2nd run 5-1).
Props: check projected minutes/role, and only take lines ≥1.5 below recent average; rebounds lines at the average were coin flips.
Fewer legs on 'safe' parlays: 3 of 3 morning parlays lost by exactly one leg or two — trim to 2-3 strongest legs.
Outdoor winter-league baseball (Mexican league) gets rained out. Postponed legs are voided and only shorten the payout, so prefer reliable leagues for Best Shot legs.
Against service-academy/option offenses, avoid 1st-quarter spreads: ball-control drives shorten the quarter (ND led Navy only 7-3 after 1Q, then won 35-13).
